task:
Goal: Watch PR #3 CI to completion, report green/red per check. No merges, no pushes, no edits. Read-only polling.

Context: Repo github.com/kolisachint/inkuno, PR #3 (agent/inkuno-0.0.1 → main, head 7ee7dad). Known pre-existing reds on main: Pages deploy (actions/deploy-pages@v4), release-checks shell-syntax/publication. If those fail on PR, attribute as pre-existing.

Steps: poll `gh pr checks 3 --repo kolisachint/inkuno` every ~3 min up to ~45 min. When all conclude (or timeout), report: per-check name → pass/fail + job link for fails; verdict MERGEABLE (green or only-known-reds) vs BLOCKED (new red with check name + link). Do NOT merge under any circumstance.

Report: status; per-check table; verdict + exact blockers if any.
